title: Granularity indexed monomial
statement: Let $\iota$ be a type, let $S$ be a finite set of indices in $\iota$, and let $x$ assign a unit sign to each index. The granularity indexed monomial of $x$ over $S$ is the product of the real sign values of $x_i$ for $i\in S$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite set of indices
$x$ assigns a unit sign to each index
